sentences.text: [scoffs] Most budgeting apps tell you what you spent... AFTER the month is over!
[laughs] Thanks, pal. Little late for that!
[excited] Hey! I'm Dollar Bill, DivvyUpp's resident raccoon!
Our founder built DivvyUpp to fix exactly that.
No report cards! It's like a GPS for your money.
[excited] It tells you what's safe to spend TODAY, before you spend it.
[excited] Okay, here's the deal. It starts with your monthly income,
and your fixed bills. Rent, mortgage, car payment, the stuff you can't skip!
What's left is your flexible money.
Some you save, the rest you spend. [excited] Alright, let's divvy it up!
Tell DivvyUpp your monthly savings goal, and boom, it works out your safe-to-spend for today,
this week,
and this month!
[excited] And here's the best part: DivvyUpp updates all three numbers as your money moves, every time a transaction hits your account.
[confident] Stay inside those numbers, and you hit your goal. Every. Single. Month.
[curious] Not sure about a purchase? Just ask!
Can I spend sixty bucks on dinner?
DivvyUpp checks your budget, your balance, AND your upcoming bills.
[cheerful] Go for it! You can afford it.
[excited] Two-fifty?
Over today's budget, but it still fits this week.
[smug] Fine. You can have it.
[gasps] A six-thousand-dollar dream vacation?
[laughs] Nope!
Your bills due this week wouldn't get paid, and your checking account would be toast!
[excited] That's DivvyUpp in a nutshell!
Know exactly what you can spend today, so you still hit your savings goal tomorrow.
Struggle to stick to a budget?
[excited] Go to divvyupp dot com and tap Get Started! It's free during the beta, no card required.
[smug] You're welcome.

voice_prefix: [excited] Whoa, whoa, whoa. I've seen your bank history! [laughs] Four coffees, two takeouts, AND a quick little online order? On a TUESDAY? [smug] Relax, pal. I'm a raccoon. I know exactly where money disappears to.
